verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a hosted AI app builder, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows that users can export the apps they build (code and database) and deploy them elsewhere. That is portability of the generated output, not self-hosting of Floot's core platform, editor, or agent, so it is adjacent and earns no credit. Nothing in the pack shows the Floot product itself can be run on user infrastructure.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: you can export the code and the database and deploy them wherever you like.
